messages:
elaine: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's All‑Hands. Recording + collaborative notes here: https://docs.redwood.ai/all-hands/2026-03. I captured the Q&A threads and some open asks below so we can triage next steps.

elaine: TL;DR action list (please react with ✅ if you own):
- Dedicated SLA wording for prospect decks -> owner: @sam
- Burst capacity pricing example & calculator -> owner: @mika
- Private deploy ETA + compliance checklist -> owner: @devon
- Migration guide for 8-bit/quantized models -> owner: @jun
- Eval suite baseline + regression alerts -> owner: @devex (we need a lead)

mika: Quick question about the burst pricing examples — should we include both monthly-commits and pay-as-you-go scenarios?

sam: yes, include both. add a small sample: 2k reqs/min sustained + 5k reqs/min burst for 1h. show cost delta. I can draft the sample language tomorrow.

devon: I'll take Private deploy ETA. I'll create INF-4332 and outline the checklist (KMS, network, OPA policies). pinging legal for certs.

jun: For the quantization migration guide, can someone drop a short benchmark bucket? like: baseline gpt-like 13B fp16 vs int8 latency on A100? I can assemble the commands.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Recording uploaded to internal storage (length 48m). Link: https://internal.redwood/ah-recordings/1945678901.mp4

amber: Suggest we have a 30m triage tomorrow to go over the items that need cross-team work (SLA language, pricing examples, compliance gaps). I'm happy to coordinate calendar.

elaine: @amber please schedule for 10:30am PT tomorrow and add a short agenda. Also — everyone listed above, please add a one-line acceptance comment in thread when you pick up the item so we can move into tickets.

mika: taking burst pricing (will add spreadsheet + a small JS calculator). ETA EOD Friday.

sam: adding SLA wording draft to the all-hands notes now.

devon: INF-4332 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4332 — assigned to me, ETA next Tue for initial checklist.

jun: I'll post the benchmark gist later today with `nb` and command block. sample command: `./bench_run.sh --model redwood-13b --precision int8 --batch 1 --seq 512`

elaine: one clarification from Q&A I want to call out: when we said "unchanged dev experience" across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, we mean API/console parity for common routes (generation, embeddings). There will still be infra-specific knobs (e.g., node sizing, private network config). If anyone flagged this for customers, please copy this phrasing.

mika: noted — will add that short clarification to the pricing FAQ.

amber: calendar invite sent (tomorrow 10:30am PT). Thanks @elaine.

elaine: final ask — if you referenced a slide number during Q&A that needs context, drop slide# + 1-line note here and I'll append to the public notes.

sam: slide 14 — SLA examples need clearer failure modes (what triggers credits). I'll add a snippet.

devon: slide 22 — Private deploy network diagram missing a step for NAT gateway config. I'll attach updated diagram to INF-4332.

jun: slide 9 — benchmark numbers were synthetic, I'll add a short caveat in notes.

elaine: thanks all. Please react with ✅ once you've posted your short confirmation so we can close this thread and move items into their tickets.
